items.description: Migrate ESLint config files to TypeScript (#86)
items.body: Every ESLint config in the monorepo is now written in TypeScript. The drift kit now guides template-derived repos through the same migration: It warns when an ESLint config is still JavaScript, and errors when a JavaScript config would shadow its TypeScript replacement. Its config checks are also no longer tied to a specific filename. The shared Vitest configs get the same TypeScript-first treatment.

items.description: Declares `#src/*` in the `package.json` `imports` of every package, `_workspace` included so that a package copied from the scaffold starts with it, and replaces the `@/` alias in `nextjs` together with its tsconfig `paths` entry, Vitest `resolve.alias`, and `import-x/extensions` override. (#164)
Place the starters under apps/ and keep packages/ for libraries (#180)
items.body: Moves the api, cdk, chrome, nextjs, and react starters from `packages/` to `apps/` and declares `apps/*` alongside `packages/*` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, which reserves `packages/` for libraries, starting with the `_workspace` scaffold. Updates `docs/new-package.md` to cover starting either an app or a library from a template.

items.description: Makes `template.unit.test.ts` in `_workspace` and `chrome` fail on a copy that keeps its template's package name or README title, where it previously compared the name with `workspace-template`, which no package uses, and passed on an unrenamed copy. (#150)
Migrate Vitest configs to the nmr projects model (#91)
items.body: `nmr test:integration` now runs only the integration tests, and `nmr test` runs everything else; previously, the integration command silently ran every test. A package that carries its own Vite config but no Vitest config now fails a drift check. The repo root now requires Node 24.16.0.

items.description: Upgrade all dependencies to latest, adopt eslint-config v6, and drop Node 18/20 (#54)
items.body:
Refreshes the template toolchain: Every dependency moves to its latest version, apart from deliberate holds on typescript, @types/node, and pnpm. Linting moves to ESLint 10 and @williamthorsen/eslint-config-typescript v6.

Two changes are breaking for template consumers. The template now requires Node ^22.13.0 || >=24, dropping the end-of-life Node 18 and 20 lines. And consumers who maintain their own ESLint setup must add @eslint/js as a dev dependency and remove both their parserOptions.project setting and their tsconfig.eslint.json file, since v6 no longer needs a separate lint-only tsconfig per package.
Repos derived from this template now require Node 24 or later; Node 22 is no longer supported. The drift kit now flags a derived repo still on an earlier Node and points it to a new migration guide.

items.description: Upgrade eslint-config-typescript to v10 and give each package its own dependencies (#107)
items.body:
Upgrades `@williamthorsen/eslint-config-typescript` to v10 and fixes lint violations surfaced by newly activated rules. Removes the root `package.json`'s `workspaces` field, which had been preventing detection of extraneous imports, and replaces inheritance from the root with explicit declarations and a pnpm catalog to pin multiple consumers to the version.

Separately, `.readyup/kits/default.ts` retires the `projectservice` checklist and the eslint-config checks that v10's own kit ships, and resolves `catalog:` specifiers so its remaining version floors still read a catalogued dependency.

items.description: Update documentation to reflect nmr adoption (#30)
items.body: Rewrites the README files to document `nmr` as the workspace script runner, replacing instructions for `pnpm run` commands that no longer exist. Every package now has a README, including the `api` and `react` packages, which previously had none.

items.description: Adds `docs/new-package.md`, which lists every file and field that a copied package must change in its own directory and in the repo, and links to it from the root README and every package README. (#150)
